PRIMER Universal Interior.name: PRIMER Universal Interior
PRIMER Universal Interior.description: Preparatory coating improving adhesion, durability, and smoothness before painting
PRIMER Universal Interior.more_detail:
PRIMER Universal Interior is a preparatory coating applied before the main paint to improve adhesion, increase durability, and provide a smoother surface. It helps seal porous surfaces, prevent stains from bleeding through, and enhance the final appearance of the topcoat.

Coverage: [60 to 80 square m/20kg ]
Finish: Gloss
Drying Time : ≈ [30 to 40 ] Min.
Application: using Brush, Roller, Spray.
